requirements.requirement: The system must validate that the new_patient_acceptance field accepts only 'yes', 'no', or 'unknown' values in the schema.
The system must validate that each new_patient_acceptance record includes a source attribution field.
The system must validate that each new_patient_acceptance record includes a last_verified timestamp in valid datetime format.
The system must correctly map explicit dataset values indicating acceptance to 'yes' during inference.
The system must correctly map explicit dataset values indicating non-acceptance to 'no' during inference.
The system must default to 'unknown' when no acceptance data is present in the input dataset.
The system must return the new_patient_acceptance field in the evaluate_care_facade response payload.
The system must return the new_patient_acceptance field in the provider_detail_service response payload.
The system must preserve consistency between stored acceptance values and values returned via API responses.
The system must handle missing acceptance-related fields without throwing runtime errors during inference processing.
The system must resolve conflicting acceptance signals by applying a deterministic rule and output a single valid value.
The system must ensure that unit tests cover at least one case of conflicting input signals resulting in a deterministic output.
The system must ensure that unit tests cover at least one case of completely missing acceptance data resulting in 'unknown'.
The system must ensure that all unit tests for acceptance logic execute successfully in the existing backend test framework.
The system must validate that invalid acceptance values are rejected during schema validation.
